Date: 2026-11-29T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Lumena Health - marketplace onramp & buying options assessment

Hi Laura — thanks for the intro call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment going into procurement: 

1) Buying intent: you mentioned preference for AWS Marketplace but want to evaluate a PO vs. corporate card purchase flow depending on internal approvals.
2) Procurement constraints: finance requires a purchase order workflow, Net-30 terms, and an itemized marketplace listing for automated invoicing.
3) Timeline: target go-live for a pilot in Q1 (you said early Jan is realistic if procurement moves quickly).

Immediate next actions I propose:
- We will prepare a preliminary marketplace listing draft (price/sku/description) and a short onboarding checklist that outlines time-to-list and required procurement artifacts. (Owner: Redwood)
- You will confirm the procurement contact and preferred cadence for a follow-up with finance/procurement. (Owner: Lumena)
- Schedule a 30-min procurement sync next week to review the PO flow and billing expectations.

I attached a short checklist template we use for Marketplace enablement. If you can share the name and email for your procurement lead (and any internal PO template), we’ll pre-fill the listing to match your fields.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
attachment: redwood-marketplace-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Laura Mills <laura.mills@lumenahealth.com>

Subject: Re: Lumena Health - marketplace onramp & buying options assessment

Thanks Vivek — great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We do prefer AWS Marketplace for procurement transparency, but Finance will only approve a Marketplace listing if the invoicing maps to our PO system (Coupa). We need to confirm if Redwood can issue invoices via the marketplace that include our PO number.
- Timeline: Procurement needs ~3 weeks to review contract language and marketplace terms; if all goes well we can list in mid-December and start a limited pilot in the first two weeks of January.
- Contacts: Evan Boyle (evan.boyle@lumenahealth.com) is our procurement lead; I’ve CC’d the group email. I’ll also upload our PO template after I run it by Legal.

Could you include a breakout showing per-seat vs. token-based pricing in the preliminary quote? That will help Finance decide which buying path to push internally.

Laura Mills
Head of Platform Partnerships
Lumena Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Lumena Health - marketplace onramp & buying options assessment

Hi all — looping in details for Marketplace enablement and what we’ll need from Lumena to minimize back-and-forth: 

- Required from Lumena: legal contact for SOW/review, vendor tax form (W-9 or W-8), PO template (if you want PO on invoices), and pricing preference (seat vs token).
- What Redwood will deliver: Marketplace listing draft (SKU, short description, billing mapping), sample invoice with PO field, and a short ops runbook for onboarding (IAM/service account steps if needed).
- Estimated time to publish: 7–12 business days from receipt of procurement artifacts and completed marketplace seller enrollment. If Lumena opts for a private offer via AWS (preferred for custom pricing), that adds ~5 business days.

Attaching our standard checklist and a preliminary worksheet I’ll use to build the quote. Vivek — I’ll start filling in the pricing options and share an XLSX you can forward.

- We are open to either token-based billing or seat-based, but Finance prefers predictable monthly billing for the pilot. Could you include a blended monthly estimate (tokens averaged to a monthly spend) in the XLSX?
